title: Migrate in two passes; the second turn only says "continue"

turns.prompt: Convert the request handlers in src/handlers/ from Node-style callbacks to `async` functions that take only `req` and resolve to `{ status, body }` (throw the HttpError instead of passing it to the callback), and make src/router.js await them. Use `db.promises` rather than changing src/db.js, and keep the tests passing without changing them. There are twelve handlers, so let's do this in two passes: in this turn convert only the handlers whose file names start with a letter from a to m, make the router work with both styles in the meantime, and then stop and tell me which handlers are left.
